mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned flagship gold project, Gascoyne region WA (786 km2 land package, 250 km east of Carnarvon; fully permitted Mining Lease). Three gold camps identified in FY2026 along an 80-km district-scale gold trend (~12 km systematically tested): Hurricane Camp (Zone 126 multi-lens high-grade: six lenses to >800 m depth; Lens 3 >350 m strike with 79 m @ 4.4 g/t Au; 15 m @ 12.7 g/t from 850 m; infill 25 m @ 10.2 g/t; 2.6 km corridor), Icon Camp (3-km wide shallow-dipping bulk-tonnage envelope; 154 m @ 1.1 g/t, 134 m @ 1.0 g/t; high-grade lens 13 m @ 29.0 g/t, 9 m @ 28.0 g/t, 17 m @ 11.0 g/t; free-milling: 95.5% extraction high-grade core, 91% mid-grade, up to 93.3% low-grade halo), Thunderbolt Camp (identified Feb 2026, Torino and Thunderbolt prospects). June 2026 maiden Exploration Target (JORC/NI 43-101): total 485-540 Mt @ 0.6-0.7 g/t Au = 10.1-12.0 Moz (higher-grade core 110-125 Mt @ 1.7-1.8 g/t = 6.1-7.3 Moz; halo 375-415 Mt @ 0.33-0.35 g/t = 4.0-4.6 Moz). Tungsten (scheelite/ferberite) confirmed across all three camps (e.g. 26 m @ 0.24% WO3) - classified critical mineral. Pre-development workstreams underway (gold flowsheet, tungsten gravity/flotation, geotechnical, hydrogeological, environmental baseline) to underpin a maiden Mineral Resource Estimate. Exploration Target is conceptual and not a Mineral Resource.
